ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What cell structure does label J point to?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a plant cell structure schematic diagram, with multiple letter labels and pointing lines around it. Label J is located on the lower right side of the image, and its pointing line goes left into the interior of the cell, pointing to a small oval organelle near the lower right; inside this structure there are striped/stacked membrane structures. Reasoning: In a plant cell diagram, a green organelle that is oval-shaped and has stacked membrane structures inside usually represents a chloroplast. Therefore, label J points to a chloroplast.
